hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The monthly-spend-feature flag was turned on at 23:22, and the code path it enables divides by zero. Error rate jumps from ~0.5% to 26-36% in the exact minute the flag evaluations flip from all-off to on, and every error in the incident is ZeroDivisionError on the account page.
supporting_evidence: 2026-09-01T23:22:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
Before onset the only errors were a different failure mode: 'UpstreamTimeout: payment authorization timed out' at ~0-1% per minute

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: Same flag, but the attempted mitigation did not actually take effect: after Argus set monthly-spend-feature off at 23:29:44 the service still logged 'monthly-spend-feature=on - 200 evaluations' at 23:30 with ZeroDivisionError continuing, suggesting the off setting was not propagated to the serving instances (stale flag cache / override at a different scope). Re-applying the disable and confirming evaluations flip to off should resolve it.
supporting_evidence: set monthly-spend-feature off at 2026-09-01T23:29:44Z: the service did not recover
2026-09-01T23:30:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero

hypotheses.summary: A code change shipped the divide-by-zero path and the flag merely exposed it; no deploy is visible, however. Change history is empty for kukibuki-service from 2026-08-20 through the alert, so no deployment can be identified as the cause from this evidence.
